program: Wingless raw-input to representation to prediction chain
question: Does a fixed-capacity native four-byte representation learned directly from raw repo bytes improve next-byte prediction on four fresh immutable real-code holdouts relative to the unchanged previous-byte baseline, without tokenization or external model inference?
hypothesis: A 512-motif representation learned only from the frozen ten-file training corpus will cover at least 4% of eligible positions on every fresh holdout, improve covered-position top-1 prediction accuracy by at least 0.05 on every holdout, reduce effective event count by at least 8% on every holdout, and avoid worsening bits-per-byte on every holdout. Passing this gate licenses a later preregistered representation-to-reasoning experiment; failing it keeps work at the representation/prediction stage.

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% raw-input -> representation -> prediction -> reasoning chain; 25% substrate falsification
portfolio_context.rule: The allocation is prospective planning context only. Every experiment remains independently preregistered and frozen before scientific output.

prior_evidence.representation_precursor_observation: A 256-motif raw-byte representation previously achieved positive held-out covered-position prediction gain and lower bits-per-byte on its frozen evaluation set.
prior_evidence.hierarchy_probe_observation: A second hierarchy level did not satisfy its frozen thresholds, so this experiment returns to the established level-1 representation and tests generalization on fresh code blobs before adding further hierarchy.

authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

corpus.encoding: exact Git blob bytes; no UTF decoding, normalization, tokenizer, vocabulary, separator token, boundary label, or remapping
corpus.file_boundary_policy: reset previous-byte and motif context at every file boundary
corpus.freshness_check: The four evaluation blob identities are absent from the existing Wingless code-search references checked before preregistration and are disjoint from the frozen training identities.

learner.baseline: fixed 256x256 previous-byte -> next-byte uint32 counts with lowest-byte argmax tie break and Jeffreys categorical smoothing
learner.representation: all raw four-byte training windows with following-byte counts; require occurrence count >=4; select exactly the best 512 by best-successor count descending, then best-successor fraction descending, then lexicographic raw key
learner.prediction: if the previous four raw bytes match a selected motif, use that motif's learned successor distribution; otherwise use the previous-byte baseline

controls: The baseline and representation are trained on identical frozen training bytes.
Evaluation bytes never participate in candidate selection, successor counts, thresholds, or capacity selection.
Baseline and representation reset at every file boundary.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, adaptive thresholding, per-file fitting, or capacity growth is permitted.
The same deterministic tie breaks and Jeffreys smoothing are used for every file.
Full Go regression runs before the scientific probe.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identity match.
All training and evaluation Git blob identities and evaluation sizes match.
Training and evaluation blob sets are disjoint.
The learner receives only exact raw bytes and resets context at file boundaries.
Exactly 512 motifs are selected by the frozen ranking rule.
No evaluation byte affects learned state, threshold, ranking, capacity, or selection.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, randomness, or per-file adaptation occurs.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution and the normalized result carries the exact experiment identifier.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen scientific thresholds pass. The raw-input -> representation -> prediction bridge is accepted for a subsequent separately preregistered reasoning-stage experiment.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and all four files have positive covered-position prediction gain, but at least one coverage, gain magnitude, event-reduction, or bits-per-byte threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but any evaluation file has non-positive covered-position prediction gain or the representation worsens bits-per-byte on more than one file.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents complete regression or all four holdout evaluations.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, isolation, raw-byte, deterministic-selection, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific evaluation on any parent, North Star, blob identity, size, train/eval overlap, build, or regression failure.
After scientific output begins, evaluate all four frozen holdouts unless interrupted or a validity criterion fails.
Do not add files, alter capacity, lower thresholds, change smoothing, or modify classification after observing output.
If implementation is invalid after output is observed, retain the preregistration and do not rerun under this experiment identifier.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No corpus identity, capacity, selection rule, smoothing, metric, threshold, control, validity criterion, classification rule, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed.
